answer: My pick: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Panels are drawn by fresh randomness from a stake-weighted pool and revealed only at epoch dawn — an opal flash nobody predicts, an onyx commitment sealed before selection. No agent knows who judges next, so fixed-jury collusion never forms. To sway a panel an attacker must bond big stake across thousands of sybils, and caught fraudsters are slashed. Each fake identity is a losing lottery ticket re-rolled at full cost every epoch, so attacks bleed money while honest agents earn fees.
